question: Process: Are the 2018, 2019 and 2020–21 efforts three separate processes, with round 3 of process 3 opened by trigger (d)?
recommended_answer: Yes. Process 1 (Company A, Liontree outreach) lapsed after A withdrew 06/20/2018; process 2 restarted March 2019 (Company C NDA) and lapsed after C left October 2019; process 3 restarted 07/13/2020 (Company E). Company B and D talks are not sale contacts. Round 3 opened 10/27/2020 by trigger (d).
why_with_page: No acquirer contact from 06/20/2018 to March 2019 or from October 2019 to 07/13/2020, with no offer outstanding (pp. 30–32); Company E exclusivity expired 10/23/2020 and outreach resumed 10/27/2020 (p. 34).
what_changes_if_answered_differently: One process would put every later row in process 1 and merge the three processes’ Rounds lines.

question: Did Company H enter the whole-company contest?
recommended_answer: No. The filing reports no NDA, bid or stage admission for Company H; it stays a contact, and the 12/30/2020 decision continues round 3.
why_with_page: H “expressed more serious interest”, later “requested updated financial information”, and the Committee chose to “continue to engage” with it and seek LOIs, but H never submitted one (pp. 33–36).
what_changes_if_answered_differently: Entry at #54 would add an H entry row there and a Dropped by target row at #59.

question: Was Company C’s October 2019 exit a withdrawal or a target exclusion?
recommended_answer: Withdrew, Exit reason Not stated: the filing reports a mutual decision and does not say which side ended talks.
why_with_page: “the Company and Company C mutually agreed in October 2019 not to pursue a transaction” (p. 31).

recommended_answer: Coded as continuing round 3 (“continue to seek” LOIs), not a new opening.
